d: We are seeking technically skilled and analytical professionals for the positions of DevOps Engineer / Cloud Engineer. These roles focus on cloud infrastructure management, software deployment automation, system reliability, infrastructure optimization, and the development of scalable technology solutions. The ideal candidates should demonstrate strong technical knowledge, problem-solving abilities, and an understanding of cloud platforms, automation technologies, and modern software development practices.

Responsibilities include designing, implementing, maintaining, and optimizing cloud infrastructure and deployment environments. DevOps Engineers will support continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, automate development workflows, manage infrastructure configurations, and improve application deployment processes. Cloud Engineers will focus on designing and managing cloud-based environments, configuring computing resources, maintaining network infrastructure, and ensuring system availability and scalability. Additional duties include monitoring system performance, troubleshooting infrastructure issues, implementing security controls, managing backup and recovery procedures, and supporting containerized applications. They will also collaborate with software development, security, and IT operations teams to improve deployment efficiency, strengthen infrastructure reliability, maintain technical documentation, and support continuous platform improvement.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline.
Strong understanding of cloud computing, infrastructure management, and DevOps principles.
Familiarity with AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform, or other cloud environments.
Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, automation, and infrastructure configuration management.
Understanding of Linux, networking fundamentals, system administration, and cloud security.
Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, Git, and container orchestration technologies.
Knowledge of scripting languages such as Python, Bash, or PowerShell.
Ability to monitor system performance and troubleshoot infrastructure issues.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Commitment to system reliability, operational security, automation, and continuous improvement.

We are seeking a qualified and compassionate Midwife to provide comprehensive maternity care throughout pregnancy, labor, birth, and the postnatal period. The successful candidate will support the health and wellbeing of mothers and newborns through evidence-based clinical practice, patient education, and collaboration with multidisciplinary healthcare teams while ensuring compliance with NHRA standards.
q: Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Midwifery or Nursing with Midwifery qualification.
Valid NHRA Midwife License or eligibility for NHRA licensing.
Minimum 3–5 years of recent Midwifery experience in a hospital or maternity setting.
BLS certification required; NRP certification preferred.
Strong communication, interpersonal, and teamwork skills.
Ability to provide compassionate, patient-centered maternity care.
Candidates outside Bahrain are welcome to apply and must be willing to relocate.
r: Provide antenatal, intrapartum, postnatal, and newborn care.
Monitor maternal and fetal wellbeing throughout pregnancy and childbirth.
Assist with labour and delivery, ensuring safe and high-quality maternity care.
Educate mothers and families on pregnancy, breastfeeding, and newborn care.
Maintain accurate clinical documentation and patient records.
Collaborate with multidisciplinary healthcare teams to deliver patient-centered care.
Participate in quality improvement and professional development activities.
